finding: Live latest-only image/encoder pairing starvation reproduced during passive sampling
timing_rootcause_evidence: 180 latest-frame/latest-encoder pairs exceeded the 80 ms skew limit while all 180 had existing feedback history within the same limit; captured image age stayed below 112 ms and all attempted shared-memory sends succeeded.
phase_delay_inference: Configured external ZED worker, CameraStream IPC polling, and NativeCamera consumer each run at 15 Hz; independent latest-value polling phases can accumulate image delay. Exact per-hop timing was not recorded.
scope_limit: Stationary read-only sensors in one process, no IK or policy workload; this reproduces the matching failure class but not the exact historical failed frame.
